annotation.title_clean: Hoja de Ruta para la Adopción Ética y Sostenible de la Inteligencia Artificial en Colombia
annotation.title_en: Roadmap for the Ethical and Sustainable Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Colombia
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Minciencias), Colombia
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombia's Ministry of Science's mission-oriented roadmap for ethical and sustainable AI adoption. It sets a baseline, five environments (ethics and governance, education and research, data, innovative industries, privacy/cybersecurity/defence), innovation routes with TRL levels, an action plan and monitoring. It is general AI policy, with no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines a mission-oriented roadmap across five AI environments
Builds on CONPES 3975, UNESCO and OECD ethics recommendations, and Colombia's Ethical Framework for AI
Baseline: about 9% of Colombian firms had adopted AI by 2022
Sets innovation routes with technology readiness levels and an action plan
Establishes follow-up and evaluation mechanisms as a living document
